name: Higuchi Kei
source:
Absolutely smitten with Airi. He is otherwise very withdrawn, self-conscious of his Kansai accent. Like Airi, his family is very overbearing so he chose a university far away.
Once he warms up to people, he's very outgoing. He's pretty good friends with Toshiro.

Favorite Color: Orange
Blood Type: A-
